title: Jackpot
description: A mod focused on adding content that is centered around the atmosphere of a Casino! This includes interactive games, blocks, items, and more!
body:
Jackpot focuses on adding interactive games that are centered on gambling! From items to enchantments, Jackpot adds all forms of new content and gameplay for players!



**Gambling**

As the theme of the mod suggests, materials and many of the mod's content is accessed through gambling within the game. Such as for the Chips, Contracts from the Dealer entity must be bought and used to gain these items.
- To get these materials, you can either way for the Dealer to spawn, or mine gold ores with a chance to get a Root Of All Evil which can be used to summon them!



**Games**

The main aspect of Jackpot is the additional games that are added. New games include the Slot Machine, Pool (Billiards), Plinko, and much more! They can be crafted with the new materials that are added by the mod.
